meta.name: game-assets
meta.description: Budget-aware asset planning, image/3D/animation generation, background removal. Load when generating or managing game assets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成和管理游戏素材，包括图像、3D和动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为游戏项目规划预算并生成各类视觉素材
copy.tagline_en: Generate and manage game assets including images, 3D, and animations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to plan budgets and generate visual assets for game projects

howto.what: Claude 会帮你规划游戏资产预算、生成图片/3D模型/动画、去除背景、提取帧、检测循环点，并整理资产清单。
howto.when: 当你需要为游戏项目生成或管理资产（如角色、背景、纹理、动画）时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个500美分的游戏资产预算，列出角色和背景。
say.note: Claude 会分析需求并分配预算。

say.text: 生成一个森林背景图片，使用Gemini模型，2K分辨率，16:9比例。
say.note: Claude 会调用命令生成图片。

say.text: 去除这张角色图片的背景，并预览效果。
say.note: Claude 会执行背景移除并生成QA预览。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you plan game asset budgets, generate images/3D models/animations, remove backgrounds, extract frames, detect loop points, and organize an asset manifest.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to generate or manage game assets such as characters, backgrounds, textures, or animations.

say_en.text: Plan a 500-cent budget for game assets, listing characters and backgrounds.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze needs and allocate budget.

say_en.text: Generate a forest background image using Gemini model, 2K resolution, 16:9 aspect ratio.
say_en.note: Claude will run the command to generate the image.

say_en.text: Remove the background from this character image and preview it.
say_en.note: Claude will perform background removal and generate a QA preview.
